body:
<!-- pr-reviewer: 98f91ea8cc5d75b718f772acb66d24459b3242d3 -->
**Not built by the runner - needs a maintainer look at the new dependency. No code blockers found.**

This PR adds the dev-dependency `truck-topology` to `crates/kernel/Cargo.toml`. By the review rules, a new dependency waits for the maintainer.

## The dependency question
- `truck-topology 0.6.0` is already in `Cargo.lock` on main, from the registry, at the same version.
- `Cargo.toml` pins it as `=0.6.0` in the workspace. `crates/app` already uses it.
- The `Cargo.lock` diff is one line: `"truck-topology"` added to the dependency list of `camcraft-kernel`.
- No new third-party code enters the build. The library crate is not changed. This is a dev-dependency only.
- No `camcraft-*` edge is added.

## What looks good
- Product code is unchanged. The PR touches no file in `crates/*/src`. Only tests under `crates/kernel/tests`, `Cargo.toml`, `Cargo.lock` and a decision file.
- The guard does not hide a disagreement. `truck_read_text` returns `Err("shell #N: face i of n (B-spline surface) not meshed: ...")` when `Guarded::refusal()` is set (`step_util/mod.rs`, after `robust_triangulation`). The bench then shows a named refusal. It is not a silent pass.
- The two new fixture rows and the third one have named verdicts. The `bspline_dome.step` row is marked as a FINDING (solidcore mesh volume off). This is honest.
- The decision file lists the options that were dropped, and says why.
- Provenance line is present. No clean-room problem seen.
- Files stay under the size limit (`truck_guard.rs` is 217 lines).

## Results merged with main (local, Windows, debug; the trial merge was "Already up to date")
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-kernel --no-run` | ok |
| `step_agreement` | 1 passed (11.2 s) |
| `step_import` | 4 passed (9.2 s) |
| `solidcraft_hostile` | 3 passed |
| `solidcraft_import` | 7 passed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-kernel --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

The runner was not used. `pr-test.yml` refuses a `Cargo.toml` diff.

## Mutation check
I turned the guard off in my worktree: `spend()` always true, and `refused()` always `None`. The pinning test `truck_side_refuses_a_runaway_face_and_obeys_its_cancel` then fails:
```
bspline_discontinuous.step: no answer 30s after its cancel (timed out waiting on channel) - a hang or a panic
test result: FAILED. 0 passed; 1 failed; ... finished in 90.02s
```
So the test pins the guard. The mutation was local only and is discarded.

## Requested before merge
None.

## Notes (not blocking)
1. Windows only. I did not run Linux, macOS or the kernel suites in release mode. I did not run `mesh_deviation_bench`.
2. `step_import.rs` ends without a newline at the end of the file. `cargo fmt` may ask for one.
3. The PR is a draft. It is flagged to be ready only by the maintainer.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
